module_title: Introduction to GST, History, and Core Concepts
introduction: Since independence, India's tax system was highly complex. The Center and States levied different taxes (like Excise, VAT, Service Tax), leading to 'Tax on Tax'. To eliminate this and unify the country into a 'Single Market', GST was introduced with the motto: 'One Nation, One Market, One Tax'.

core_concepts.title: What is GST?
core_concepts.description: It is a comprehensive 'Indirect Tax' that has replaced multiple other indirect taxes in India (such as Excise Duty, VAT, Service Tax, and Octroi). It is levied on the supply of both Goods and Services.

core_concepts.title: Date of Implementation and Committee
core_concepts.description: GST came into effect in India from the midnight of 'July 1, 2017' (which is why July 1 is celebrated as GST Day). The concept of implementing GST in India was initially suggested by the 'Vijay Kelkar Committee'.

core_concepts.title: Destination-based Tax
core_concepts.description: This is the most crucial concept. GST is a 'Destination-based' or 'Consumption-based' tax. This means the tax revenue will go to the State where the goods are 'consumed', NOT the State where the goods were 'manufactured'.

core_concepts.title: Dual GST Model
core_concepts.description: India has adopted a 'Dual GST Model' based on the 'Canadian model', where both the Central and State governments have the power to levy and collect taxes simultaneously.

important_entities.name: Cascading Effect
important_entities.significance: The biggest advantage of GST is that it eliminated the 'Cascading Effect' (the problem of paying tax on an already taxed item), making goods cheaper in the long run and doing business much easier.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: The Direct vs. Indirect Tax Trap
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: A very basic but common mistake: GST does NOT replace Income Tax. Income Tax is a 'Direct Tax'. GST is strictly a replacement for 'Indirect Taxes' only.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: July 1st marks three major events in India: 1. SBI Foundation Day, 2. National Doctor's Day, 3. GST Day.

exam_strategy_tips: The committee name 'Vijay Kelkar' and the implementation date 'July 1, 2017' are all-time favorite questions in SSC and Railway exams.
